role.altitude: The funeral home manager keeps meeting families, supervising staff, inspecting operations and judging what is right; checking files for missing papers, retyping details into forms, counting stock and adding up estimates shrink.
skills_to_grow: Running every funeral from one digital file
role.ambitious_version: A manager who never has a funeral delayed by a missing permit and spends the time with families.

tasks.short: Check funeral files for required permits and documents, inspect operations, judge deviations and record checks and corrective actions to monitor funeral service operations for compliance with policies, regulations and laws.

steps.what: Funeral home manager checks each funeral file for required permits and documents
Funeral home manager inspects operations: preparation room, hygiene and storage
Funeral home manager judges deviations and decides corrections
Funeral home manager records checks and corrective actions

tasks.design: Each funeral has a digital file with a checklist of required documents per stage, such as the death certificate, death report and burial or cremation permit, and the system lists files with missing or late items. Inspecting the premises and judging deviations stay with the manager. Checks and corrective actions go into a register with due dates.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper files were checked one by one for missing documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Funeral management systems with document checklists.
tasks.still_hard: Unusual cases such as deaths abroad or unnatural deaths.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when a shortcut would hurt a family's trust.
tasks.altitude: Less file checking; inspection and judgement stay.

reach.learn: Whether missing documents are caught earlier.

evidence.claim: A records app for obligations with versions, approvals and review dates replaces spreadsheets.
Burial or cremation needs a permit from the municipality after the death is reported.

assumptions: Boundary: monitoring compliance in the funeral home; inspections by authorities are outside.
Input contract for s1: documents uploaded to each funeral file by staff as they receive them, as part of the file workflow.

Inspection and judgement keep their full time. s4 keeps 80: the document checks are recorded by the file checklist itself, but writing inspection checks and corrective actions is a first record and stays.
research_questions: Are delays from missing documents fewer?

already_counted.description: Funeral home manager follows up flagged files.

incremental.description: Funeral home manager keeps the document checklist current with the rules.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: staff upload documents late, so the manager still checks many files by hand and s1 keeps 75 (11.2); high: documents uploaded as received and the checklist used as designed (18.7).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan staff for each funeral, direct and supervise the work of embalmers, funeral attendants, death certificate clerks and other staff, handle staff issues and check work completion.

steps.what: Funeral home manager plans which staff handle each funeral: in a spreadsheet and by phone today, on the funeral board with staff availability after the change
Funeral home manager checks the final staff plan: each funeral's tasks, who does them and their availability
Funeral home manager publishes the checked assignments to staff on the funeral board
Funeral home manager directs and supervises embalmers, funeral attendants and other staff
Funeral staff tick each task off on their phones as they finish it
Funeral home manager handles staff issues and problems
Funeral home manager checks that each funeral's tasks are done

tasks.design: Each funeral's tasks sit on a board in the funeral management system, and the manager plans staff there, seeing availability, checks the plan and publishes the assignments, instead of a spreadsheet and phone calls. Staff tick tasks off on their phones, so the manager sees what is done. Directing, supervising and handling staff issues stay in person. The board shows tasks per funeral, not staff speed, and its use is agreed with staff representatives.

approvals.approved_version: The staff assignments per funeral exactly as checked by the manager in s1b, published once to the assigned staff on the funeral board; any change needs a new check.

tasks.previous_blocker: Plans were kept in spreadsheets and progress checked by phone.
tasks.enabler_now: Task boards in funeral management systems with mobile ticks.
tasks.still_hard: Last-minute changes when a family's wishes shift.
tasks.human_edge: Supporting staff through emotionally hard funerals.
tasks.altitude: Less planning admin; leading people stays.

reach.learn: Whether clear task lists reduce mistakes.

evidence.claim: Rosters and tools able to monitor staff need works council consent.
Scheduling is a configured product; working-time rules are constraints.

assumptions: Boundary: directing staff on funerals; hiring is outside.
Input contract for s4: staff tick tasks on their phones as they finish them (s5, share 1).
Supervision and staff issues keep their full time.

incremental.description: Funeral home manager keeps task templates per funeral type current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: availability on the board is incomplete, so phone calls stay and s1 keeps 80, and staff tick tasks unreliably, so s4 keeps 90 (5.2); high: the board and ticks used as designed (11.7).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Have the family enter details, complete the funeral file, prepare state-required documents such as the death report and permit application, check and submit them, keep tracking documents of the deceased and maintain product inventories.

steps.what: Family gives the personal details of the deceased: in the meeting today, in the online form after the change
Funeral home manager completes the funeral file with the details and arrangements
Funeral home manager prepares state-required documents: the death report and the permit application
Funeral home manager checks the final death report and permit application against the certificate and identity papers
Funeral home manager submits the approved documents to the municipality
Funeral staff scan the identification tag of the deceased at each transfer
Funeral home manager maintains tracking documents of where the deceased is
Funeral home manager confirms the products actually used when closing each funeral file
Funeral home manager maintains product inventories of coffins, urns and supplies

approvals.approved_version: The death report and permit application exactly as checked by the manager in s4 against the certificate and identity papers, submitted once in the municipality's portal for this deceased; any change needs a new check.

tasks.design: Families who want to can enter the deceased's details in an online form that fills the funeral file; others give them in the meeting as today. The death report and permit application are filled from the file and the doctor's certificate, and the manager checks and submits them in the municipality's portal. Staff record each transfer of the deceased by scanning the identification tag. When the manager closes a funeral file with the products actually used, those lower stock, and a count list shows what to check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Details were written on paper and retyped into forms and stock lists.
tasks.enabler_now: Funeral management systems with form filling, tag scans and stock lists.
tasks.still_hard: Deaths abroad and unnatural deaths with extra rules.
tasks.human_edge: Getting the name and details exactly right for a grieving family.

evidence.claim: Records and reports can be generated from the source system without re-keying.

assumptions: Boundary: records and documents for funerals; the municipality's decision is outside.
Input contract for s2: details entered by families in the online form (s1), about half of families; the rest are typed by the manager.
Input contract for s6: identification tags scanned by staff at each transfer (s8, share 1).
Input contract for s7: products actually used, confirmed by the manager when closing the file (s9, share 1), not the products first chosen; supplier deliveries booked on receipt.
Families' effort on the form is about what giving details in person took and sits in s1.
Checking and submitting keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of families who use the online form.
research_questions: Do errors in death reports fall?

incremental.description: Funeral home manager helps families with the online form when asked.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: only a quarter of families use the form, so s2 keeps 80, and tags are often not scanned, so s6 keeps 80 (31.8); high: about half of families use the form and staff scan every transfer (40.5).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Meet the family about their wishes, show products and options, prepare the cost estimate, check it and hand it over, and record the agreement to sell funeral services, products or merchandise to clients.

steps.what: Funeral home manager meets the family and discusses their wishes for the funeral services
Funeral home manager shows products, merchandise and options
Funeral home manager prepares the cost estimate
Funeral home manager checks the final estimate: chosen options, prices and total against the family's wishes
Funeral home manager gives the approved estimate to the family
Funeral home manager records the agreed services and products in the funeral file

approvals.approved_version: The cost estimate with chosen options, prices and total exactly as checked by the manager in s4, handed once to the family who chose these options; any change needs a new check.

tasks.design: Products and options sit in a digital catalogue with photos and prices on a tablet. Options the family chooses go straight into the funeral file, which computes the estimate from the price list. The manager checks it and gives it to the family; once agreed, the file holds the order. Talking with the family stays fully personal.
tasks.previous_blocker: Estimates were added up by hand from price lists.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital catalogues linked to the funeral file and price list.
tasks.human_edge: Helping a family choose without pressure.

reach.learn: Whether clear estimates reduce disputes about costs.

evidence.claim: Bills from items times price list are deterministic code.

assumptions: Boundary: selling services and products; carrying out the funeral is outside.
Input contract for s3: options chosen in s2 and the price list kept by the manager.
Conversation, checking and handing over keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of custom requests outside the catalogue.

incremental.description: Funeral home manager keeps the catalogue and price list current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: many custom requests are not in the price list and are priced by hand, so s3 keeps 75 (7.7); high: mostly standard options priced from the list as designed (13.0).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
